---

**Country and organisation**

**Who is asking** — named contact, role, and whether the ministry is aware.

**The card** — what it is (front, back, fold-out), the language, and roughly how
many data elements it carries.

**What you can supply** — blank template, dummy cards with known values, a
location list, an existing digital export, nothing yet. Be honest: the ground
truth is the entry ticket.

**New concepts** — list any field the card carries that is not in
`docs/concepts/concepts.yaml`, with the card's own wording and language.

**What you want from the test** — accuracy on your own cards, a review screen, a
map, an export to your system, a feedback report, something else.

A country pack is reviewed against `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the checklist in
`countries/_template/README.md`.
